mapper.select: SELECT r.alarm_no, r.rule_id, r.instance_id, i.instance_name, i.host_ip, i.redis_port, r.metric_name, r.alarm_level, r.alarm_content, r.trigger_value, r.threshold, r.unit, r.trigger_time, r.recover_time, r.recover_status FROM alarm_record r INNER JOIN redis_instance i ON r.instance_id = i.instance_id WHERE r.recover_status = 0 ORDER BY r.trigger_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.alarm_no, r.rule_id, r.instance_id, i.instance_name, i.host_ip, i.redis_port, r.metric_name, r.alarm_level, r.alarm_content, r.trigger_value, r.threshold, r.unit, r.trigger_time, r.recover_time, r.recover_status FROM alarm_record r LEFT JOIN redis_instance i ON r.instance_id = i.instance_id ORDER BY r.trigger_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) as "alarmTotal", COUNT(CASE WHEN recover_status = 0 THEN 1 END) as "unrecoveredCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN recover_status = 1 THEN 1 END) as "recoveredCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = 1 THEN 1 END) as "infoCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = 2 THEN 1 END) as "alarmCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN alarm_level = 3 THEN 1 END) as "severityCount" FROM alarm_record WHERE trigger_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
